start.text: Nets hang out to dry for the first time since the Snuffing, tarred and new-mended. Every one begins at the same corner, with the same small, stubborn knot.
Someone has tied a gull's feather into the first mesh of each, for luck.

knot_burned.text: New nets hang on the frames, or the middles of them do. Each was begun in the centre and worked outward. None of them has a first knot.
They'll hold fish just the same.
At the corner of one frame someone has tried to tie something seven times, and cut it away seven times. The cut ends are still hanging there.
